profile.headline: Software Engineer | Digital Designer | HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node | Adobe Creative Suite
profile.summary:
Software engineer with strong attention to detail, problem solving skills, and the ability to learn quickly, seeking a job in the tech industry. Excited to use my skills in engineering and design to bring people’s ideas to life. Utilizing my knowledge of software engineering and my skills in digital design, I create interactive, accessible, and beautiful websites.

During my time in the BrainStation software engineering program, I developed HadoFinder, a web application designed to help fighting game players find tournaments and local communities around them. This site was built using a React front end, as well as an Express back end, with the information being stored in a MySQL database. I also utilized Axios to make multiple API calls to an external data source as well as my own server. The site also supports server-side authentication with JWT.

Contribute to the development and user experience of the UNIRA app.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain the company’s parking lot management systems, implementing features, and troubleshooting and fixing issues with the software.
Designed and developed the company’s website.
Worked with an interdisciplinary, multi-lingual team.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description: ● Designing and developing a website for an architecture agency leveraging React on the front end to display a gallery view of pictures and other media to promote architecture work to clients.

positions.title: Marketing Associate
positions.description:
● Took and edited pictures of the company’s products to be utilized in
their website and promotional material. These pictures are currently
being displayed in the Visology site and are the main way for
customers to see their merchandise.
● Designed a preliminary logo for the company. This logo was utilized in
their early merchandise prototypes, as well as in early marketing
material and apparel.
positions.insights: Skills: Image Editing · Photography · Adobe Photoshop

positions.title: Jr. Graphic Designer
positions.description:
● Created social posts, trade show flyers, emails, and other promotional
material, working together with brokers and other company teams.
● Managed marketing material utilizing a proprietary CRM and CMS, as
well as took part in the migration to a new CRM, speeding up the
promotional material creation process.
● Executed several marketing campaign releases, getting vital
promotional material in the hands of partner brokers.
positions.insights: Skills: Video Editing · Print Design · Typography · Graphic Design
